Hi lovelies, I got you! 🤍✨ Etsy Seller Tips | Canva Digital Products  If you're thinking about selling editable Canva templates on Etsy, here's one of my biggest tips: avoid Canva Pro elements whenever possible!!! Not everyone purchasing your templates will have Canva Pro, so sticking to free elements helps your customers edit their designs without unexpected charges or watermarks! Look out for that little crown icon when choosing elements and fonts!  I personally love creating my own components in Figma, too! And always test your templates using a free Canva account before listing them! 🤭How to make money online selling products on Etsy you didn't make yourself using the done for you designs & print on demand method!  👇🏼Read for a step by step!  🙌🏼 How Print On Demand Works:  1. Do Some Quick Product Research - Look for popular items people are buying, like wall art, t-shirts, sweatshirts, phone cases, candles, mugs, or tote bags.   - Use tools like erank, Google Trends or browse online shops to see what's trending. I also look for inspo on Pinterest all the time! I like to use Everbee to see how much money a product is making on Etsy.  2. Create Your Design  - Get done for you designs on ctrl-alt-design.com  - Or create your own. Make your design fun, eye-catching, or niche-specific. Keep it simple and high-quality!   3. Sign Up on Printify  - Create a free account & make sure you connect your account to a store. Examples being Etsy or Shopify. You are walked through how to do this when you sign up, don’t worry it’s easy and fast.  4. Choose a Product on Printify   - Browse the product catalog for posters, t-shirts, hoodies, candles, hats, mugs, phone cases & etc.   - Select the product you want to sell.   5. Upload Your Design   - Click on the product to customize it.   - Upload your design.   - Position and resize it to fit the product nicely.   6. Fill Out Listing Details  - Write a catchy product title and description with keywords.   - Set your price (consider costs and your profit margin).   7. Publish Your Product  - Remember to connect your online store (Shopify, Etsy, etc.) with Printful . This makes it so whenever you make a sale, Printify knows instantly so it can print the design on the product for you and send it to the customer for you!  - Publish your product so it’s live and ready for customers.   8. Market Your Product - Share your product on social media, use Pinterest, create ads, or tell friends. Make videos of your product or make Pinterest pins.  - Focus on your target audience to attract more buyers. Not a must but it can help!  #howtomakemoneyonline #sidehustle #onlinesidehustle #printondemand #digitalproducts

Etsy sellers, before you panic about the new AI image rules… READ THIS. 👇 Etsy is NOT banning AI-generated images or mockups across the board. But there are some important distinctions sellers need to understand. Here's what you need to know: ✨ AI-generated digital products are still permitted when they meet Etsy's Creativity Standards, including disclosure requirements. ✨ Print-on-demand sellers can still use qualifying mockups, but your images need to accurately represent the product your customer will receive. ✨ Handmade and physical product sellers have stricter photo requirements. Not every AI-generated lifestyle image is acceptable as a replacement for real product photography. #etsysellersoftiktok #etsysmallbusiness #printondemand #fyppp #etsymockups

Etsy acaba de cambiar las reglas de la IA 🚨 Las nuevas reglas de Etsy si vendes print on demand o diseños con IA, en menos de 2 minutos 👇 El correo nos llegó a todos los que tenemos tienda y lo firma uno de los vicepresidentes de Etsy. Son 3 cambios: 1️⃣ La foto: la mayoría de los listings ahora tienen que llevar una foto real del producto, sin editar. En print on demand puedes seguir usando mockups, pero con los derechos de su dueño. Si tu mockup enseña un color que no es, el cliente puede abrir un caso y el reembolso lo puedes pagar tú. Y vale también para los listings que ya tienes. 2️⃣ Bots: los listings creados en automático, sin una persona detrás, se borran y te pueden cerrar la tienda. Los patrones, recetas y guías hechos con IA también quedan fuera. 3️⃣ Etsy revisa tus fotos: detecta las hechas con IA y más adelante revisará las que ya tienes. Los compradores van a poder reportar tu listing si creen que las imágenes son engañosas. ¿Etsy prohíbe la IA? No: prohíbe esconderlo. La IA se sigue declarando en la descripción (al final del vídeo tienes un ejemplo para hacerle captura). 💬 ¿Te llegó el correo? ¿Usas IA en tus diseños? 🎥 Más tutoriales en mi canal de YouTube (enlace en mi perfil): https://www.youtube.com/@EduarLias 🔎 ZEUS, la herramienta que uso para saber qué vender: https://zeusseller.com/es/ #etsy #printondemand #diseñosconia #inteligenciaartificial #etsyseller
